currentObservations.title: Agent能力验证与治理约束并行出现
currentObservations.summary: Agent 平台相关指标已同时出现能力评测与企业治理约束两类信号：PhoenixRepair 在 MiniMax-M2.5 下达到 76.0% Pass@1 解决率，DeepDebug 在 GAIA 基准修复后整体准确率达到 63.6%；与此同时，允许凭据共享的组织中 63.5% 发生过安全事件或近失事件。证据关系为跨来源并行信号，不表示已建立因果关系。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 同对象相关能力指标显示 Agent 任务解决能力已有可量化验证，同时跨来源治理数据表明企业使用约束问题已显现。该并行信号补充了对象当前理解：Agent 平台相关研究需要同时关注任务效果与治理控制，而非单一能力指标。

facts.subject: repair_exploration_approach
facts.statement: PhoenixRepair 采用多智能体框架，系统性探索多个候选编辑位置，并对补丁生成进行迭代反思与优化

evidence_cards.source_quote: we present PhoenixRepair, a multi-agent framework that systematically explores multiple candidate edit locations and performs iterative reflection and refinement on patch generation

facts.subject: patch_generation_workflow
facts.statement: PhoenixRepair 流程为多位置采样（困难任务可选引入基于图的定位信息）、迭代反思与优化生成更优补丁，并由历史尝试提炼的洞见指导终轮生成

evidence_cards.source_quote: Our framework begins with multi-location sampling, optionally augmented with graph-based localization information for difficult tasks, followed by iterative reflection and refinement to generate better patches, culminating in final-round generation guided by distilled insights from all historical attempts.

facts.subject: skill_retrieval_shared_background_bias
facts.statement: SkillSight论文指出，技能检索中将技能描述当作普通文档会忽略其规律化结构，跨技能反复出现的共享描述模式会系统性推高稠密相关性得分并产生显著能隙。

evidence_cards.source_quote: shared descriptive patterns recur across many skills while providing little evidence for distinguishing the required capability. We show that this shared descriptive background systematically contributes to dense relevance scores, induces a pronounced energy gap between queries and skill documents, and obscures task-relevant signals.

item.html:
• In the orchestration control layer, 68% of enterprises plan to adopt, add, or replace platforms within 12 months and 34% within the quarter.
  • Fifty-seven percent of enterprises traced a confident, wrong agent answer in the past six months to their own missing or inconsistent business context.
  • Organizations that allow credential sharing anywhere experienced a security incident or near-miss at a 63.5% rate (47 of 74), against 40.9% (nine of 22) at companies where every agent has its own scoped identity.
  • Sixty-nine percent of companies let at least some of their agents share credentials — multiple agents operating under one API key or service account.
  • Half of enterprises shipped an agent that passed internal evaluations and then caused a customer-facing failure in the past year.
  • Only 5% of enterprises fully trust the evaluations that would gate removing human review.
  • Two-thirds of enterprises either already allow an agent to push a code or system change to production on automated evaluation results alone, with no human review, or are actively engineering toward that within 12 months.
  • 理想汽车2025年上半年借助世界模型完成约4000万公里仿真里程，而实车路测仅约2万公里。
  • AWS发布博文《Evaluating AI Agents: A production blueprint with Strands and AgentCore》，介绍如何为自有代理构建该评估流水线。
  • 该评估流水线由Motorway与AWS共同构建。
